# netactuate_resource_tags (Data Source)

Reads tags assigned to a supported NetActuate resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_resource_tags" "example" {
  identifier    = "12345"
  resource_name = "virtual_server"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identifier` (Number) Resource identifier to read tags for
- `resource_name` (String) Resource type name accepted by the tag API

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags` (List of Object) Tags assigned to the resource (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `color` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `icon` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `is_default` (Number)
- `is_favorite` (Number)
- `is_locked` (Number)
- `mb_id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `resources` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedobjatt--tags--resources))
- `resources_count` (Number)
- `show_dashboard` (Number)

<a id="nestedobjatt--tags--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags.resources`

Read-Only:
